answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 36278 Country: India Title: Before mentioning my dream, I want to share with you that I have lots of love and respect towards Hadhrat Imam Hussain and Ahl al-Bait Question: Before mentioning my dream, I want to share with you that I have lots of love and respect towards Hadhrat Imam Hussain and Ahl al-Bait. In my dream, I have seen some people sitting in a group chaired with one or two persons and calling me as Hussaini, Zaheer Abbas. But I told them, my name is Zaheer Abbas. There reply was that, my name has been changed as Hussaini, Zaheer Abbas. Please let me know the meaning of this dream. Answer ID: 36278 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 278/L=174/TL=1433) It is your love with Ahl al-Bait that you were attributed to Hadhrat Hussain (رضى الله عنه). You should send durood extensively on the holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم), his family and his Companions. In-sha-Allah, it shall increase your status. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
